title: Odile and the Tryouts
author: Ansel Underhill
blurb: Noor Fairweather, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
